items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: A case in point is John Allred, who is here at this festival. Excellent player with a lot of facility and he knows how to make music with it too.

ctx.x: I’ve seen in colleges and high schools that trombone players are getting a bit scarce. Have you seen that?

Yeah. I guess it’s true. I hear a lot about it, but I also hear about young trombone players coming up — very, very good players too. A case in point is John Allred, who is here at this festival. Excellent player with a lot of facility and he knows how to make music with it too.
